verdict.rationale: Bruno CLI lets users run entire collections (many requests) at once from the command line, supports CI/CD pipelines and Docker-based batch runs, and generates aggregated reports (JSON/JUnit/HTML) across all items — a clear bulk-execution capability confirmed hands-on (npx CLI works). Missing for 10: evidence of bulk editing/modifying many requests/environments at once (beyond running them), and independent community corroboration of large-scale bulk usage.
